---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new check for iconlens
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What accessibility gap or workflow pain are you hitting? Describe the SVG asset
that iconlens does not currently handle. Note the relevant WCAG requirement or
ACT rule where you can.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like iconlens to do. If you are proposing a new rule, sketch the
check and the failure it should report; if it changes accessible-name
computation, describe the SVG-AAM path involved.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
